p: times of trouble: As soon as we enter into affliction, we think God should help us, but that is not always his due time.
boasteth of his heart's desire: The wicked man rejoices in his own lust he boasts when he has that he would; he brags of his wit and wealth and blesses himself and thus blasphemes the Lord.
never be in adversity: The evil will not touch me, Isa 28:15 or else he speaks thus because he never felt evil.
He sitteth in the lurking places: He shows that the wicked have many ways to hide their cruelty and therefore should be even more feared.
poor may fall by his strong: By the hypocrisy of them who have authority the poor are devoured.
Arise: He calls to God for help, because wickedness is so far overgrown that God must help now or never.
require it: Therefore you must punish their blasphemy.
requite it with thy hand: To judge between the right and the wrong.
none: For you have utterly destroyed him.
heathen are perished out of his: The hypocrites or such as live not after God's law, will be destroyed.
To judge the fatherless and the: God helps when man's help ceases.
